title: Propagation-Invariant Transmission Eigenmodes in Weakly Scattering Media
abstract: Propagation-invariant beams (PIBs) with annular angular spectra preserve their transverse intensity structure over extended propagation distances. Here, we investigate whether scattering invariant modes (SIMs) can simultaneously exhibit scattering and propagation invariance. We measure free-space and sample transmission matrices (TMs) in an orthonormal annular basis for weak, moderate, and strong scattering media and identify localized SIMs (LSIMs) whose angular spectra remain predominantly confined to one or a few neighboring rings. Under weak scattering, 75 of the 128 SIMs considered for annular localization satisfy this criterion, with LSIMs exhibiting Bessel-like propagation. Under moderate scattering, 25 LSIMs are recovered after filtering low-intensity spectral components, whereas none are found under strong scattering. Although increasing modal crosstalk progressively suppresses annular localization and nondiffracting behavior, SIMs retain higher transverse-intensity correlation over propagation than the Gaussian-like and Bessel beams in the moderate and strong regimes. These results show that annular localization enables SIMs to acquire propagation invariance when scattering is weak, whereas the enhanced propagation robustness of SIMs can persist even after this localization is lost.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally and via transmission-matrix analysis identifies localized scattering invariant modes with annular angular spectra that preserve nondiffracting, Bessel-like intensity over long propagation in weak scattering but increasingly lose this annular localization under stronger scattering, while still retaining higher transverse-intensity correlations than Gaussian or Bessel beams even when localization fails.
summaries.zh: 论文通过传输矩阵实验与分析，识别出具有环形角谱的局域散射不变模，其在弱散射条件下能在长距离传播中保持类似非衍射的贝塞尔式横向强度；随着散射增强，环形局域逐渐被削弱直至消失，但在中强散射下散射不变模即便失去局域特性仍比高斯或贝塞尔光束表现出更高的传播过程横向强度相关性。

title: Photoluminescence study of Vanadium in 4H- and 6H- Silicon Carbide
abstract: Point defects with optically addressable spin states are a key building block for quantum networks, but few solid-state emitters combine a spin-photon interface with emission in the low-loss telecommunications band. Vanadium (V4+) defects in silicon carbide (SiC) meet this requirement, emitting zero-phonon lines (ZPLs) throughout the telecom O-band in both the 4H- and 6H-SiC polytypes while retaining an addressable electron and nuclear spin system [1,2]. Although the orbital and spin structure of these defects has been characterized in detail, the polarization selection rules have not been fully mapped experimentally. Here we present polarization-dependent photoluminescence (PL) measurements of vanadium ZPLs in 4H- and 6H-SiC at cryogenic temperature, of two scattering geometries: edge and face-on (emission wavevector perpendicular and parallel to the crystal c-axis, respectively). Emission from two of the four {\alpha} sites, ({\alpha}2 and {\alpha}3) and the 6H-SiC {\gamma} sites, are polarized parallel to the c-axis ({\sigma}-polarized), whereas emission from {\alpha}1 and {\alpha}4 are polarized perpendicular to the c-axis ({\pi}-polarized). Additionally, we report preliminary, lower signal measurements of the \b{eta} sites.

summaries.en: The paper reports cryogenic polarization-dependent photoluminescence measurements of vanadium (V4+) zero-phonon-line emitters in 4H- and 6H-SiC, showing which α and γ defect sites emit σ-polarized (parallel to the c-axis) versus π-polarized (perpendicular) light, with preliminary results for η sites.
summaries.zh: 本文在低温条件下对4H和6H-SiC中四价钒（V4+）缺陷的零声子线进行偏振相关的光致发光测量，结果表明哪些α与γ缺陷位点分别发射σ偏振（沿c轴）与π偏振（垂直于c轴）的光，并给出了η位点的初步低信号结果。

title: Topological Spatiotemporal Mode-Locked Lasers
abstract: Achieving robust high-dimensional solitons both in optics and Bose-Einstein condensates remains a great challenge, due to unpredictable high-order perturbations. Here we propose and demonstrate a novel topological spatiotemporal mode-locked fiber laser empowered by mode-division multiplexing, for precisely controlling of the spatiotemporal solitons. By introducing time delays between the individual transverse mode paths, a topological spatiotemporal lattice is formed in the multimode cavity, which in turn excites periodic spatiotemporal solitons. These solitons are stable against the perturbations, attributed to periodic potentials induced by the nonreciprocal dissipative coupling interactions. Moreover, under the thermodynamic limit, the solitons condense into nested-type spatiotemporal solitons, a phenomenon analogous to the Bose-Einstein condensate of matter waves. Our results indicate that topological spatiotemporal mode-locked lasers not only constitute a controllable source of robust spatiotemporal light bullets, but also provide a valuable platform for exploring nonlinear high-dimensional soliton dynamics and non-Hermitian topological physics.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and experimentally demonstrates a topological spatiotemporal mode-locked multimode fiber laser that uses mode-division multiplexing and engineered time delays to create a topological spatiotemporal lattice generating stable periodic spatiotemporal solitons via nonreciprocal dissipative coupling, with solitons condensing into nested-type states analogous to Bose-Einstein condensation under the thermodynamic limit.
summaries.zh: 论文提出并实验实现了一种借助模分复用的拓扑时空锁模多模光纤激光器，通过在各横向模路径间引入时间延迟构建拓扑时空晶格，从而激发由非互易耗散耦合诱导的周期性稳定时空孤子，并在热力学极限下出现类似物质波玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚的嵌套型时空孤子凝聚现象。

title: Optical Signals Synthesized from an Optical Lattice Clock with Uncertainty of 1.3E-17
abstract: We report an accurate optical frequency synthesizer, which can generate single-frequency laser light with high frequency stability and accuracy at desired frequencies over a wide optical region. The frequency of the output signal is divided from an 171Yb optical lattice clock via an accurate optical frequency divider based on an optical frequency comb. Therefore, the output of the optical frequency synthesizer inherits the frequency accuracy from the Yb optical clock. The frequency uncertainty of the 171Yb optical lattice clock is evaluated to be 6.8 mHz, corresponding to a fractional frequency uncertainty of 1.3E-17, mainly limited by the blackbody radiation shift and the lattice-induced light shift.

summaries.en: The paper reports an accurate optical frequency synthesizer that derives single-frequency laser light at requested optical frequencies from a 171Yb optical lattice clock using an optical frequency comb divider, achieving a clock fractional frequency uncertainty of 1.
summaries.zh: 论文报道了一种高精度光学频率合成器，通过基于光学频率梳的精密分频器，将171Yb光学晶格钟的频率转换到所需宽光学范围内的单频激光输出，从而继承晶格钟的频率准确度；该171Yb光学晶格钟的不确定度为6.

title: Full-Vector Diffractive Deep Neural Networks
abstract: Conventional diffractive deep neural networks (D2NNs) treat polarization as independent channels and rely on scalar or semi-vectorial propagation models, which neglect cross polarization coupling and vector diffraction. Here we propose a vector D2NN (V-D2NN) that embeds the full vector angular spectrum method into the end-to-end training pipeline. This physically rigorous framework describes vectorial light-matter interactions across cascaded diffractive layers, enabling direct optimization of polarization conversion, spin-orbit coupling, and vectorial interference without external polarization optics. We demonstrate the V-D2NN on polarization-multiplexed tasks--ector beam generation, polarization dependent imaging and classification, and multiple channel optical encryption--where it consistently outperforms scalar and semi-vectorial counterparts. In longitudinal-field engineering, the V-D2NN actively shapes a prescribed longitudinal field with a normalized correlation of 0.839, a capability inaccessible to scalar-propagation models. An open-source training framework is also provided to support further development of vectorial diffractive optics for computing, sensing, and communications.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a full-vector diffractive deep neural network that incorporates the complete vector angular spectrum into end-to-end training to model cross-polarization coupling and vector diffraction, demonstrating improved performance over scalar/semi-vector models on polarization-multiplexed tasks and enabling longitudinal-field engineering with high correlation, with an open-source training framework provided.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种全向量衍射深度神经网络，将完整向量角谱模型融入端到端训练以刻画交叉偏振耦合与向量衍射，在偏振复用任务中相较标量/半向量模型表现更好，并实现高相关度的纵向电场整形，同时提供开源训练框架以促进向量衍射光学进一步发展。

title: Impact of Stimulated Brillouin Scattering on Modulation Instability in Fiber Fabry-Perot Resonators
abstract: We report the experimental and numerical demonstration of stimulated Brillouin scattering-induced stabilization of Kerr-driven modulation instability in fiber Fabry--Perot resonators. We show that Brillouin scattering shapes the modulation instability spectrum into a stable multi--free-spectral-range cascade that is otherwise unstable in the absence of Brillouin effects. We further identify that this stabilization originates from the real part of the Brillouin response, leading to an asymmetric Kerr-Brillouin interaction governed by the relative position of the Brillouin frequency shift with respect to the cavity resonances. These results establish stimulated Brillouin scattering as an additional degree of freedom for controlling nonlinear dynamics in Kerr resonators.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally and numerically shows that stimulated Brillouin scattering can stabilize Kerr-driven modulation instability in fiber Fabry–Perot resonators by reshaping its spectrum into a stable multi-free-spectral-range cascade through an asymmetric Kerr–Brillouin interaction determined by the Brillouin frequency shift relative to cavity resonances.
summaries.zh: 该论文通过实验和数值验证，受激布里渊散射能在光纤法布里-珀罗谐振腔中稳定由克尔效应驱动的调制不稳定性：布里渊散射将不稳定的谱重塑为稳定的多自由光谱程级联，且这种稳定源于布里渊响应的实部，体现为由布里渊频移相对腔谐振位置所决定的非对称克尔-布里渊相互作用，从而提出受激布里渊散射可作为控制克尔谐振器非线性动力学的额外自由度。

title: Inverse Design of Integrated Photonic Components for Visible-Light Applications
abstract: Photonic integrated circuits (PICs) operating in the visible spectral range are crucial for quantum technologies, optical sensing, and nonlinear optics applications. However, their development is hampered by limited integration density and operational bandwidth, linked to low refractive index contrast and restricted parameter space in intuition-based PIC design. We address these bottlenecks with an adjoint-based, fabrication-aware inverse design workflow tailored for visible-spectrum photonics. By expanding the capabilities of FDTDX, an open-source, GPU-accelerated FDTD solver, we provide a versatile memory and runtime efficient inverse design platform. Demonstrating this approach on a silicon nitride (Si3N4) platform, we design, fabricate, and experimentally validate ultra-compact, broadband components for light routing, multiplexing, and polarization control. This work provides a scalable framework for high-density, high-performance visible-light PICs.

summaries.en: The paper presents an adjoint-based, fabrication-aware inverse design workflow with an expanded GPU-accelerated FDTD platform (FDTDX) to create and experimentally validate ultra-compact, broadband visible-light integrated photonic components on a Si3N4 platform for routing, multiplexing, and polarization control, enabling scalable high-density PICs for quantum, sensing, and nonlinear optics applications.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种基于伴随法、考虑工艺约束的可见光逆向设计流程，并通过扩展开源GPU加速FDTD求解器FDTDX来提高内存与运行效率，在Si3N4平台上设计、制造并实验验证用于光路、复用与偏振控制的超紧凑宽带可见光集成光学器件，为高密度高性能可见光PIC提供了可扩展框架。

title: Simulations of Fluorescence and Energy Transfer in Periodic Systems: Pitfalls and Considerations for Bound States in the Continuum
abstract: Bound states in the continuum (BICs) combine high quality factors with strong electromagnetic-field localization and are therefore widely explored for enhancing light--matter interactions. However, large field amplitudes do not directly translate into useful fluorescence enhancement or energy transfer enhancement between two donor--acceptor fluorophores. Here, we investigate this question for a hybrid plasmonic--photonic resonant waveguide grating supporting a symmetry-protected BIC. We emphasize some of the pitfalls associated with the numerical simulations, especially the utilization of periodic boundary conditions for fluorescence. Strong BIC-related fields can enhance acceptor absorption while useful fluorescence enhancement remains moderate. Extensive simulations and the comparison of different figures of merit, indicate that, while a BIC can suppress radiative leakage, it can also redirect a large fraction of the energy into Ohmic losses. As a result, the useful fluorescence enhancement of donors remains moderate, whereas absorption by acceptors can be strongly enhanced in Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET) experiments. It is essential to separate near-field FRET from long-range energy transfer and reabsorption mechanisms, both of which are mediated by the delocalized BIC mode. Finally, results obtained for finite gratings are compared with infinite periodic simulations and conceptual inconsistencies explained. This work provides a consistent framework for interpreting fluorescence, absorption, and energy transfer in BIC-based periodic nanophotonic systems.

summaries.en: The paper shows that while symmetry-protected bound states in the continuum in a periodic plasmonic–photonic resonant grating can strongly localize fields and suppress radiation, numerical simulation choices (especially periodic boundary conditions) can mislead fluorescence predictions, yielding only moderate donor fluorescence enhancement but potentially large acceptor absorption and thus stronger near-field FRET, with careful separation of mechanisms and finite-vs-infinite grating comparisons required for consistent interpretation.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在周期性杂化等离子体—光子谐振光栅中受对称性保护的连续态束缚态虽然能强烈局域电磁场并抑制辐射泄漏，但数值模拟设置（尤其是周期性边界条件）可能会误导对荧光的预测；结果通常是供体荧光增强幅度有限，而受体吸收可能显著增强从而使近场FRET更强，并且需要区分不同能量转移与再吸收机制、同时对有限光栅与无限周期仿真进行对照以获得一致的物理解释。

title: RF-Resolved RIN Engineering of High-Power CW Yb Fiber Laser Architectures Using Seed Topology, Seed Power, Pumping Geometry and Cavity FSR
abstract: We report, to the best of our knowledge, the first controlled, like-for-like experimental mapping of how four practical design parameters--seed-cavity topology, seed power, amplifier pumping geometry, and seed-cavity free spectral range (FSR)--jointly shape the radio-frequency (RF)-resolved relative intensity noise (RIN) of high-power continuous-wave (CW) Yb-doped fiber lasers. We compare a standalone bidirectional fiber Bragg grating (FBG) oscillator, an FBG-seeded master-oscillator power amplifier (MOPA), and unidirectional ring-seeded MOPAs with FSRs of approximately 11.5 and 5 MHz, all near 1064 nm at a common 72 W output, with RIN measured from 10 kHz to 1 GHz. Across all settings, the low-frequency RIN is technical-noise limited and nearly architecture-independent, whereas RIN above 160 kHz is governed by the seed-cavity topology and its transfer through the amplifier. Higher seed power suppresses the mid- and high-frequency RIN, but the seed-alone and amplified-output comparison reveals opposite transfer for the two topologies: for FBG seeding the 2 MHz-1 GHz RMS RIN increases through amplification (3.66 percent to 4.14 percent at 15 W seed), whereas for ring seeding it decreases (1.47 percent to 1.35 percent). Forward pumping gives the best power-scaling/noise trade-off, while reducing the ring FSR from approximately 11.5 to 5 MHz preserves the high-frequency RIN advantage, confirming it is not a mode-spacing effect. At matched conditions, ring seeding lowers the integrated RMS RIN by 2-3 times (160 kHz-2 MHz) and approximately 3 times (2 MHz-1 GHz, approximately 9-10 dB to near -127.4 dBc/Hz). These results yield band-resolved design rules linking each band to its dominant lever. The unidirectional ring-seeded MOPA thus offers a simple, scalable route to broadband pump-RIN suppression for nonlinear and frequency-conversion photonics.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally maps how seed-cavity topology, seed power, amplifier pumping geometry, and cavity FSR jointly control RF-resolved RIN in high-power 1064-nm CW Yb fiber lasers, finding architecture-independent technical noise at low frequencies but topology-driven RIN transfer at high frequencies, with forward pumping and smaller ring FSR preserving lower high-frequency RIN and ring seeding reducing integrated RMS RIN by about 2–3× (160 kHz–2 MHz) and ~3× (2 MHz–1 GHz).
summaries.zh: 论文以受控同等条件实验系统地评估种子-腔拓扑、种子功率、放大器泵浦几何和腔体FSR如何共同决定高功率1064 nm连续波掺镱光纤激光的RF分辨RIN，结果显示低频RIN主要受技术噪声限制且几乎与架构无关，而高频RIN由拓扑及其通过放大的传递机制主导；其中前向泵浦与降低环形腔FSR可保持较低高频RIN，环形种子在160 kHz–2 MHz与2 MHz–1 GHz频段分别使积分RMS RIN降低约2–3倍和约3倍。

title: Temporal chirality in Floquet photonic media
abstract: We reveal temporal chirality in time-modulated photonic media: reversing the orientation of a closed loop traced by the complex permittivity can leave the Floquet spectrum unchanged while strongly modifying the directional scattering response under the same excitation. This behavior is linked to two symmetry constraints on the evolution operator, namely pseudo-Hermiticity and pseudo-unitarity. We prove the general occurrence of temporal chirality based on a complex Bogoliubov parametrization of the scattering amplitudes. We illustrate these findings in a single-harmonic temporal-$\mathcal{PT}$-symmetric system: both modulation-loop orientations support the same vacuum-like Floquet photonic bands at the phase transition, but one suppresses backward photon generation whereas the other induces strong growth, as confirmed by full-wave simulations. Our results establish temporal chirality as a distinct notion in time-varying photonics and identify modulation-loop orientation as a control knob for Floquet wave dynamics.

summaries.en: The paper shows that in time-modulated photonic media, reversing the orientation of a modulation-loop can leave the Floquet spectrum unchanged while dramatically altering directional scattering, a phenomenon proven to arise from pseudo-Hermiticity and pseudo-unitarity constraints on the evolution operator and illustrated in a temporal-PT-symmetric system where one loop orientation suppresses backward photon generation while the other strongly enhances it.
summaries.zh: 论文揭示在时间调制的光子介质中，改变调制回路的取向会使得浮特谱保持不变却显著改变定向散射响应，这种现象由演化算符满足的伪厄米性与伪幺正性两种对称性约束所导致，并通过贝戈柳博夫参数化的散射幅度证明其普遍存在，进一步在单谐时域-PT对称系统中表明两种回路取向都在相变点提供类似真空的浮特光子能带，但一个会抑制后向光子产生而另一个会引发强烈增长，并由全波仿真证实。

title: Harnessing Machine Learning for Ultrafast Science in Facility Settings: Opportunities and Challenges
abstract: Ultrafast science is rapidly evolving from a collection of specialized laser experiments into a facility-scale, data-intensive research endeavour. High-repetition-rate femtosecond and attosecond sources, synchronized multidimensional diagnostics, and increasingly nonlinear laser-matter interactions now generate heterogeneous data streams whose volume, speed, and complexity often exceed the capacity of conventional manual workflows. This chapter examines how machine learning can become an enabling layer for next-generation ultrafast facilities, with emphasis on the Extreme Light Infrastructure (ELI) ecosystem. We discuss the scientific drivers for artificial-intelligence-assisted experimentation, propose a facility-scale digital architecture spanning acquisition, ingestion, storage, analytics, machine learning, adaptive feedback, and user interfaces, and review representative examples from ELI ALPS, ELI Beamlines, and ELI-NP. The central thesis is that machine learning should not be treated merely as an offline data-analysis tool; rather, when constrained by physical insight and embedded in robust data infrastructure, it can support real-time diagnostics, surrogate modeling, anomaly detection, experimental optimization, and progressively autonomous discovery workflows.

summaries.en: The paper argues that machine learning, integrated into a facility-scale digital infrastructure at ultrafast facilities like the ELI ecosystem, can enable real-time and more autonomous experimentation beyond offline data analysis despite challenges posed by heterogeneous, high-volume experimental data.
summaries.zh: 论文指出，在像ELI生态系统这样的超快光学设施中，将机器学习嵌入到设施级数字基础架构里，而不仅仅把它当作离线数据分析工具，能够在面对异构且高速的大规模实验数据带来的挑战时，实现实时诊断、实验优化与逐步更自主的发现流程。

title: Spatiotemporal computing for temporal nonlinear tasks using few-mode fiber and SOA nonlinearity
abstract: Step-index few-mode fibers (FMFs) provide a compact passive platform for high-speed photonic information processing by exploiting modal dispersion to map temporal inputs into spatiotemporal representations with short-term memory. In previous studies, we have demonstrated linear classification tasks with such FMFs, such as ultrafast multibit header recognition. Here, we extend the computational capability of such architectures towards solving nonlinear tasks by introducing an optical nonlinearity at the output of the dispersive medium. The FMF output is processed through parallel direct and nonlinear branches, with the latter implemented using a nonlinear semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA). We experimentally evaluate the architecture at 28.5 Gb/s on two delayed XOR and higher-order parity tasks. We show that combining the direct and SOA-transformed representations reduces classification errors and broadens the range of operating conditions supporting low-error classification. In addition, by exploiting multiple temporal samples within each bit period as independent classifier features, we increase the dimensionality of the photonic representation and improve the computational performance.

summaries.en: The paper proposes using a step-index few-mode fiber with added SOA output nonlinearity to perform nonlinear temporal classification tasks, experimentally demonstrating improved XOR and parity performance at 28.

title: Quantum non-Markovian response spectra
abstract: Quantum systems are rarely isolated from their surroundings. These hidden environments can retain information and return it later, producing correlated errors in quantum computers and complicating the interpretation of this http URL a quantum processor, for example, one job can therefore leave an environmental trace that affects the next, even after the qubits themselves have been reset. Learning how this hidden influence persists and affects later behavior is therefore important, but the environment is often impossible to measure directly, and fully reconstructing its effects through tomography rapidly becomes impractical. Here, we introduce a response matrix that uses controlled interventions and observations of the system alone to reveal the temporal structure of environmental memory. The matrix records how future observations change across different controlled histories. Its spectrum characterizes how memory is structured and how it persists under specified system resets, while suitable linear combinations of its entries can rule out specified classical models of that memory. Because its history-future queries can be evaluated independently, numerical response matrices can be assembled in parallel. We establish the framework theoretically, characterize response spectra in an interacting spin process, and certify quantum memory in a two-qubit benchmark. This approach turns system observations into a probe of inaccessible environments and could support the diagnosis of correlated noise, tests of open system models, and memory-aware control design.

summaries.en: The paper introduces a response-matrix framework that, using only controlled interventions and system-only observations, reconstructs the temporal spectrum of non-Markovian environmental memory and enables parallelizable certification of quantum memory while ruling out classical memory models and benchmarking it on interacting spins and a two-qubit system.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出一种响应矩阵框架，通过仅对量子系统进行受控干预和系统自身观测来重构非马尔可夫环境记忆的时间结构谱，并可并行计算以完成量子记忆认证、排除经典记忆模型，同时在相互作用自旋过程和双量子比特基准上进行了理论刻画与验证。

title: On linearity or non-linearity in machine learning for quantum chaotic dynamics
abstract: Accurately simulating chaotic quantum many-body dynamics remains a major computational challenge for classical methods, due to the rapid buildup and spatial spreading of entanglement during the evolution. This raises the question of whether machine learning can provide an effective alternative for predicting quantum dynamics. We address this question by formulating quantum dynamics as a time-series forecasting problem, using a few-qubit PXP chain, realizable with Rydberg-atom arrays, as a benchmark. By varying the initial state, the system spans dynamical regimes ranging from ergodic behavior to quantum many-body scarring, providing a controlled setting for testing forecasting models across qualitatively different dynamics. We compare two contrasting architectures: an expressive nonlinear Transformer and DLinear, a simple linear forecasting model. The Transformer accurately predicts dynamics in the more ergodic regime, but its performance progressively deteriorates as the initial state approaches the scarred limit. In contrast, DLinear remains accurate across the entire family of initial states, with its main deviations consisting of small high-frequency oscillations that have little effect on the overall prediction error. Remarkably, these results show that observables generated by complex quantum many-body dynamics can be forecast with high accuracy through a simple linear mapping from past to future observations. This reveals that the complexity of the underlying quantum evolution need not translate into an equally complex forecasting problem.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

summaries.en: The paper reframes chaotic quantum many-body dynamics as a time-series forecasting task using a few-qubit PXP (Rydberg-atom) benchmark, showing that while a nonlinear Transformer excels in an ergodic regime but degrades near quantum many-body scarring, a simple linear DLinear model stays accurate across all initial states, implying that the complexity of quantum evolution may not require nonlinear forecasting models.
summaries.zh: 本文将混沌量子多体动力学重表述为时间序列预测问题，使用可由里德堡原子阵列实现的少量量子比特 PXP 链作为基准；结果表明，非线性的 Transformer 在遍历（ergodic）区域表现良好但在接近量子多体擦伤（scarring）极限时逐渐变差，而简单线性的 DLinear 在所有初始态下都保持高精度，说明潜在量子演化的复杂性不必然意味着预测任务也需要同样复杂的非线性模型。

title: Quantum Networking at the Speed of Quantum Computation: Kilohertz Entanglement in a Heterogeneous Quantum System
abstract: Distributed quantum computing requires rapid, high-fidelity entanglement between qubits in separate processor modules. Photonic links between single-atom qubits provide switchable, long-range connections, but photon loss limits their entanglement rate. Here we entangle a trapped $^{138}$Ba$^{+}$ ion with a silicon-vacancy (SiV$^{-}$) center in a diamond nanophotonic cavity. A photon emitted by the ion is converted in wavelength and encoding, reflected from the SiV$^{-}$--cavity system and detected, so that a single detected photon heralds entanglement. Including all conversion losses, we generate ion--SiV$^{-}$ Bell pairs at an average rate of 1.03(1)\,kHz with a fidelity of 87.9(7)\%. This is four times the rate of the fastest photonic link between two trapped ions and corresponds to one Bell pair per millisecond, matching the cycle time of planned trapped-ion processors.
